title: Deno is joining Cloudflare
summary: The Deno team is joining Cloudflare to radically simplify self-hosting Workers and Durable Objects, so developers can use the same primitives in more places.
content:
The Deno team is joining Cloudflare to radically simplify self-hosting Workers and Durable Objects so developers can use the same primitives in more places.

For what this means and how it came about, here’s the story from Ryan Dahl and Kenton Varda.
